name: InfoLabel
summary: A Label followed by a small information button that opens a popover of explanatory text. Use it on a field whose name needs a sentence of help; use a tooltip when the help is one short line and a link when it leads elsewhere.

inputs.name: info
inputs.description: The popover's content; without it no info button renders.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Passed to both the label and the info button: the button's icon is 12, 16 or 20px and the popover's text caption1 at small and medium, body1 at large.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Passed to the label, which appends its asterisk.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: The info button's popover renders in DOM order rather than a portal.

anatomy.name: InfoLabel
anatomy.description: An inline span holding the label and the button; it adds no styles.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The Label component, aligned to the top and inheriting the cursor and colour.

anatomy.name: InfoButton
anatomy.description: A transparent icon button after the label, aligned to the top and pulled up and down by spacingVerticalXXS (1px at large) so its icon lines up with the text.

anatomy.name: Info icon
anatomy.description: The default info circle at 12, 16 or 20px by size, regular at rest and filled while hovered, pressed or open.

anatomy.name: Info popover
anatomy.description: A Popover above-start of the button with an arrow, size small (medium at large) and a note role; its surface is at most 264px wide.

variants.description: 20px icon in a button padded spacingVerticalXXS, pulled 1px up and down; popover size medium with body1 text.

layout.text: The button is an inline flex box with no border, borderRadiusMedium corners, no margin and spacingVerticalXS by spacingHorizontalXS padding; at large the padding is spacingVerticalXXS on every side.
Both label and button align to the top of the line; the button takes negative top and bottom margins of spacingVerticalXXS (1px at large) so it does not stretch the line.
The default icon is 12px at small, 16px at medium and 20px at large.
The popover opens above-start of the button with an arrow, at size small for small and medium buttons and medium for large; its surface is at most 264px wide in caption1 (body1 at large).

states.text: Transparent background with a Foreground 2 regular icon.
Transparent Background Hover with the icon in Foreground 2 Brand Hover, swapped to its filled twin; the pointer is a hand.
Transparent Background Pressed with Foreground 2 Brand Pressed.
While its popover is open the button reads Transparent Background Selected with Foreground 2 Brand Selected and the filled icon.
The default 2px colorStrokeFocus2 outline outside the button (createFocusOutlineStyle).

behaviour.text: A click, Enter or Space on the button opens its popover; a second toggles it closed, as do Escape and a click outside.
Focus leaving both the button and the popover closes the popover.
The popover never opens on hover; openOnHover is withheld from the popover slot.
While open, the root reports aria-owns of the popover so the label and its help read as one.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens and closes the popover
semantics: the button's aria-label is information and it is labelled by the label and itself
the popover surface is a note labelled by its own id
the root owns the popover while it is open

notes.text: The 264px popover maximum width, the 12/16/20px icons and the 1px large-size margins are constants; the padding and alignment margins are tokens.
The pressed state does not swap to the filled icon by itself; only hover and the open (selected) state do, so a keyboard press shows the regular icon until the popover opens.

The icon sizes, the popover's above-start placement, arrow, size mapping and note role are set in useInfoButton.tsx, which the kit's citation pattern cannot name; the styles file's line references stand in.
Under forced colours the button's icon is CanvasText, hover and press paint Highlight with Canvas text, and the open state paints Highlight with Canvas text.
